title.orig: An Act Declaring September Twenty-nine of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of San Miguel, Province of Leyte, to Be Known as the "San Miguel Day"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7791_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The twenty-ninth day of September of every year, being the annual town fiesta of San Miguel, Leyte, honoring its most holy patron saint, St. Michael the Archangel, is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of San Miguel, Province of Leyte, to be known as the "San Miguel Day."

On September twenty-nine of every year, the municipal officials of San Miguel, Leyte, shall lead appropriate and meaningful celebrations, activities, and programs participated in by regional heads of departments and other government offices and their employees holding office in San Miguel, Leyte, civic, sports, religious, and nongovernmental organizations and private companies doing business in San Miguel, Leyte.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
